summary: This is a Form 424B5 prospectus filed by Bridgecrest Auto Funding LLC, as depositor, for Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2026-3, an asset-backed securities issuance. The trust is issuing $725 million in notes backed by subprime auto loan receivables, with $662.83 million offered to the public across six tranches (Classes A-1 through D) at par with coupons from 3.997% to 5.59%, plus a Class E note retained or privately placed. Credit enhancement includes overcollateralization, a reserve account, and subordination. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation. There are no deal terms applicable.
